description: Synthetic AuditReport receipt verification vectors. Reports carry offsets, labels, actions and SHA-256 hashes of synthetic placeholders only. Regenerate with python scripts/parity/generate_receipt_vectors.py --write.

test_keys.material: OpenMed receipt vectors v1: test only, never production
test_keys.note: Published test material. Never sign a real report with it.

canonical_json.escape: lowercase \uXXXX; astral characters as UTF-16 surrogate pairs
canonical_json.floats: shortest round-trip repr as Python prints it (1e-07, 5e-324, 1e+16, 1.0)

span_orders.sorted: spans sorted by (start, end, canonical_label, action, canonical JSON of the span), strings compared by code point
span_orders.stored: spans in the order the report stores them

payloads.repro: the report without repro_hash and signature; its SHA-256 is the repro_hash, written sha256:<hex>
payloads.signing: the report without signature, keeping the stored repro_hash; HMAC-SHA256 of it is signature.value

verification: A report verifies when signature is an object whose algorithm is HMAC-SHA256 and some span order, tried sorted first and then stored, has a repro hash equal to the stored repro_hash and a signing-payload HMAC equal to signature.value. Anything else does not verify.
